nodes.description: uint8 public state variable holding the minimum percentage increase required for each new bid
uint256 public state variable holding the fee percentage taken by the haus address on settlement
uint256 public state variable identifying the ERC1155 token sold in the auction
address of the ERC1155 token contract used for external calls
bool public flag tracking whether the auction has been finalised
address allowed to call pull() to recover the NFT if no bids were made
address of the contract deployer, set from msg.sender in the constructor
uint256 public current highest bid amount (initialised to the reserve price)
address payable of the current winning bidder, receives refunds and the NFT
uint256 public duration of the auction once started (24 hours)
uint256 public auction start timestamp, assigned from block.timestamp
uint256 public auction end timestamp, derived from block.timestamp and extended near the end
address payable receiving the protocol fee on settlement
address payable receiving the remaining proceeds of the auction
constructor initialising token, fee, seller, haus and controller settings and setting deployer = msg.sender
public payable bid() function: refunds previous winner via transfer before updating lastBid/winning, uses msg.sender, tx.origin and block.timestamp
public end() function transferring the ERC1155 to the winner and distributing ETH to haus and seller
public pull() function restricted to controller, returning the NFT to the seller when there were no bids
public view live() returning block.timestamp < endTime, used as a guard in end() and pull()
public view containsAuctionNFT() querying ERC1155 balanceOf of this contract
external pure ERC1155 receiver hook returning the acceptance selector
untrusted caller address used for bidder identity, tx.origin comparison and controller checks
untrusted transaction origin compared against msg.sender to reject contract callers in bid()
miner-controlled timestamp used for startTime, endTime extension and live() checks
external ETH transfer to the previous winning bidder executed inside bid() before lastBid and winning are updated
external ETH transfer of the protocol fee computed from balance and hausFeePercentage in end()
external ETH transfer of the entire remaining contract balance to the seller in end()
external IERC1155.safeTransferFrom call in end() handing the NFT to winning, can invoke receiver callback
external IERC1155.safeTransferFrom call in pull() returning the NFT to seller, can invoke receiver callback
constructor parameter for the auctioned token id
constructor parameter for the ERC1155 token contract address
constructor parameter setting the initial lastBid reserve price
constructor parameter setting the protocol fee percentage
constructor parameter setting the minimum bid increase percentage
constructor parameter setting the seller payout address
constructor parameter setting the fee recipient address
constructor parameter setting the controller address permitted to pull()
local uint8 constant 100 used as the percentage denominator in bid()
local uint256 computed as base + percentageIncreasePerBid in bid()
local uint256 caching address(this).balance in end()
local uint256 fee amount derived from balance and hausFeePercentage in end()

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in bid() to validate the caller and to record the new winning bidder
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in bid() to reject calls originating from contracts
block.timestamp is assigned to startTime, making auction start miner-influenceable
now/block.timestamp is used to set and extend endTime in bid()
live() derives its result from block.timestamp compared with endTime
winning is assigned msg.sender when a new bid is accepted
lastBid is read in bid() to compute the minimum acceptable next bid
percentageIncreasePerBid is read in bid() to compute the required bid multiplier
lastBid is the value sent to the previous winner through an external transfer
winning is the untrusted recipient address of the external transfer in bid()
the external transfer is executed inside bid() before lastBid and winning are updated, allowing reentrancy
controller is used in the msg.sender == controller access check in pull()
the ended flag guards re-execution of end()
the ended flag guards re-execution of pull()
end() performs the external IERC1155 safeTransferFrom call
tokenAddress is the target of the external ERC1155 call in end()
tokenId is passed as the token id argument to safeTransferFrom in end()
winning is passed as the recipient argument to safeTransferFrom in end()
end() executes the external haus fee transfer
end() executes the external transfer of the remaining balance to the seller
haus is the recipient address of the fee transfer
seller is the recipient address of the remaining balance transfer
hausFeePercentage is used in the fee arithmetic feeding the haus transfer
end() writes ended = true after settlement
bid() updates the lastBid state variable with msg.value
bid() updates the winning state variable
bid() writes the startTime state variable on the first successful bid
bid() writes and possibly extends the endTime state variable
bid() writes the length state variable when the auction starts
end() requires that the auction is not live via live()
pull() requires that the auction is not live via live()
pull() performs the external IERC1155 safeTransferFrom call
tokenAddress is the target of the external ERC1155 call in pull()
seller is the recipient of the NFT in pull()
pull() writes ended = true after returning the NFT
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom in end() invokes the receiver hook on the recipient contract
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom in pull() invokes the receiver hook on the recipient contract
containsAuctionNFT() reads tokenAddress to build the external balanceOf call
containsAuctionNFT() uses tokenId in the external balanceOf call
end() requires winning != address(0) to proceed with settlement
lastBid is emitted as the winning amount in the Won event from end()
msg.sender is stored into deployer during construction
